`overlap.vtt` is synthetic overlapping auto-caption-style material created for this fork.

`youtube-rolling.vtt` comes from the public YouTube auto-caption fixture `captionVtt1` in
https://github.com/sabbaken/vtt-to-text/blob/main/test/fixtures.ts . That project describes it
as a verbatim port of its original fixture. It includes YouTube inline timestamps, rolling
text and blank lines before text. Its MIT licence is preserved in SABBAKEN-LICENSE.txt.
This is a public regression fixture, not an export of the user's own footage.
